# Mythos 0.2.1

## Codex and images

- Fixed Codex merges failing with "project activation is no longer current" when the same project is refreshed.
- Merged Codex cards now appear beneath their surviving entry and remain available to open.
- Imported, cropped, and AI-generated Codex images appear in Assets with filenames and display names based on their Codex entry. Alternate generated images receive numbered names.
- Improved portrait and AI reference-image pickers with spacious thumbnails, filename/display-name search, and enlarged hover previews.

## Assets and Reference

- Assets are sorted by display name, with unused images grouped in an automatic Orphaned folder.
- Asset details list both document and Codex usage. Unused images can be deleted from the project and disk; images still in use are protected.
- Usage links offer View in Reference alongside Open in Editor for documents or Edit in Codex for Codex entries.
- View in Reference scrolls to and briefly highlights the image in the document or dossier.
- Reference remains available when AI agents are offline, and navigation protects active Reference edit drafts.
- Gold scrollbar handles improve visibility in the default Aurum theme.

## Updates

- An available update appears as a blue Update button in the workspace. Open it to read release notes and begin updating without going through Settings.
- Asset changes update the relevant UI without reloading the entire project.

This maintenance release retains the established taxonomy-and-lore extraction workflow. The experimental G1-G9 auto-extraction pipeline is not enabled in the normal extraction workflow.
